utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and who’s actually bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not totally sure yet, Mina—I haven’t heard the latest list. I can ask around while I’m out and let you know who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please do, and pin down names if you can. We need to know by tonight whether we’re short on drills, ladders, or extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard you’re organizing the repair drive—count me in if you need tools, a workbench, or an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Gus, that’d be great—thanks. I’m still sorting the details, but tools and an extra pair of hands would definitely help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, just let me know the day and what kinds of repairs you expect, and I’ll bring the right tools along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Pia, have you heard when the repair drive is kicking off? I’ve been meaning to spread the word to a few folks on my block.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t heard a firm start time yet, Tess, and I’d hate for folks to show up too early. Maybe we should check who’s coordinating before you spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good thinking, Pia — I’ll hold off for now and see if I can find out who’s coordinating before I tell anyone a time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Opal, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—first, could you help me confirm which repair tables are set up in the community room and which supplies are still over by the east entrance?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Opal—I’ll check the community room tables first, then swing by the east entrance and report back what’s still there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m helping get the word out about the repair drive—want me to swing by with the details and pass the invite along to a few folks on your block?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate the details, though I’m keeping to myself a bit right now—feel free to pass the invite along to the others.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, Uli—I’ll drop the details by for you and spread the word to the others without putting you on the spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving—do you have a sense of which neighbors need help first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the folks who have safety issues first—broken locks, leaks, or no heat. I can help make a quick priority list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Leo—let’s put broken locks, active leaks, and no heat at the top. I’ll start calling around this afternoon, and if you can jot down any names you already know, we’ll compare lists.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane, before we jump into the repair drive, can you tell me what needs fixing and who’s already offered to help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just catching up, Hana, so I don’t have the full list yet. Tell me what you’ve heard so far, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard any confirmed details yet, so I don’t want to guess. Let’s first make a list of known repairs and volunteers, then we can fill in the gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’d love to help with the repair drive—do you know what day and time you’re thinking? I’m juggling school pickup and aftercare, so I want to see where I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning, maybe 10 to noon, so it doesn’t run into school pickup or aftercare. Would that window work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday 10 to noon should work for me, thanks for keeping it clear of the school shuffle. I can help with check-in or sorting repairs during that window.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Jules, I’m still catching up through what folks have told me—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Nell! The repair drive’s picking up steam—Mara’s crew is sorting tools, and I’m trying to connect them with Sam’s group for extra hands this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to hear—if you find out when Sam’s group is showing up, could you let me know? I’d like to pass along accurate times instead of half-heard updates.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I caught something about the repair drive—what do you need from me, in the simplest version?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not signing onto rumors, Bo—can you confirm the repair drive is actually happening and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Fair point—I don’t have a confirmed name yet, just heard chatter. I’ll check who’s actually organizing it before asking you for anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Oren, I heard a little about the repair drive, but not much yet. What are folks hoping to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Rey—if I’m remembering right, folks want to start with the wobbly benches by the green and maybe the leaky shed roof, though I should double-check the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—those benches have been shaky for a while. If you do check the list, I’d be glad to hear what tools or help they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I’m trying to get the word out about the repair drive—do you know what time folks should start bringing things by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d tell folks to start bringing things by around 10 in the morning, so we’ve got time to sort supplies before it gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, I’ll tell everyone to start bringing things by around 10 in the morning so there’s time to sort supplies.
